changes: Connect River as a Matrix device to use Gravitas rooms and rooms from other Matrix servers.
Open threads update as Matrix messages arrive, including rooms hosted on other servers.
Send and read end-to-end encrypted messages, threads and Matrix attachments. Existing rooms can enable encryption for future messages.
Verify your devices by showing or reading a Matrix QR code, using a camera where available, or comparing numbers. Confirm the scan before trusting another device.
Restore your encryption identity and older messages using a verified device or an encrypted recovery key.
Keep Matrix sessions and private keys on the device. Encrypted sends stop when the Matrix connection is unavailable.
Matrix attachments support files up to 32 MiB. Public posts, room details and existing SFU calls retain their separate visibility and security settings.
